2025Jemný řez / Soft CutGalerie Kuzebauch, Prague

Sheet glass broken and assembled by hand, held by balance rather than glue. Two objects stand in the gallery and one in the garden, open to rain, wind and sun. Around them hang light-sensitive prints of glass shadows and fractures.

2025MATCHESSedlec Cathedral, Kutná Hora

Glass panels made in 2012 and shown here for the first time. Matches salvaged from waste were laid tip to tip, so the flame ran from one to the next and burned circles and triangles into layered glass. The panels hung in the roof structure of Santini's cathedral, with a video of the burning and the painting Jasná hvězda in the choir loft.

Dates
1 Jan – 31 Mar 2025
Venue
Cathedral of the Assumption of the Virgin Mary and St John the Baptist, Sedlec, Kutná Hora

2023Lom toku(A)VOID Gallery, Prague

Hundreds of thin glass rods hung on threads from a steel frame in a vault of the river wall, under the Dancing House. Fans and the open doors kept the air moving, so the rods swung and knocked together. In the afternoon the low sun made the cloud shimmer; after dark, lasers threw caustics through it into the fog.

Dates
24 Aug – 14 Sep 2023
Venue
(A)VOID Gallery, Rašínovo nábřeží, Prague 2

About

Lukáš Kalivoda (b. 1986) is a Prague artist working with glass, water, light and sound. He studied in the glass studio at UMPRUM under Vladimír Kopecký and Rony Plesl. His installations are processes rather than objects: glass moved by wind, light thrown by the sun, paint lifted from water.
